typescript.description: Architectural directives, strict typing, and best practices for the modern TypeScript ecosystem.
architecturalRules: Modular architecture and decoupled components adhering to the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP)
DRY Principle: maximum reusability and zero logical duplication
Immutability by default: use readonly, immutable objects, and reactive Signals
Strict separation between presentation layer, business logic, and data access
Strict typing enabled (strict: true) with zero tolerance for the any type
Zero tolerance for dead code, orphan imports, or unused variables
Automated unit and integration tests for critical business logic
uiDesignRules: Modern dev-tool aesthetics (Dark-mode first, glassmorphism, translucent micro-borders)
Mandatory responsive design (complete adaptability on mobile, tablet, and desktop)
Reusable atomic UI components (buttons, inputs, selectors, modals)
WCAG accessibility compliance and contemporary readable typography

go.description: Directives for idiomatic Go development, high concurrency, and resilient microservices.

Standard Go project layout (cmd/, internal/, pkg/)

Unit and integration testing using standard testing package and table-driven tests
